timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Scarf is an exciting single-player adventure game mixing puzzles and 3D platforming.
But you won't have to do it alone, as you can rely on the help of your trustworthy companion.
Create a bond with the scarf and unlock new abilities that will allow you to master
Glide, hook, and slingshot your way through three colorful and magical worlds.
Hidden within the levels lies the story of the world.
It is up to you to find fragments of this story by searching for those secret places.
Will you be able to find the links?

youtube_description:
#Scarf #IndieGames #PuzzlePlatformer

The gorgeous and exciting 3D single-player adventure platformer SCARF is out now on PC!

Wholesome. More than a word, rather a feeling that describes the holiday season around Xmas. International publisher HandyGames, together with developer Uprising Studios, might be considered "daring" or just "crazy" to date the release to the day before Christmas Eve. Also, offering a more than reasonable price for a game of this class and scale is quite unusual. 

But HandyGames wants to give something back in those challenging times. And what says "Thank You!" better than giving a beautiful triple-I game to the community? All in all, the holidays are about making people happy.

Make (yourself?) a present on Steam https://tinyurl.com/SCARF-STEAM
Get a gift for a loved one (yourself?) on GOG https://tinyurl.com/SCARF-GOG
Stuff your stockings on Epic Games Store https://tinyurl.com/SCARF-EPIC

Now, kick back, relax and experience a rich world with unexpectedly deep narrative lore. All of this is wrapped in a peaceful, family-friendly package.

#UprisingStudios #HandyGames
